//: A fake Serverless Jobs API for development. See Program.cs for what it is and is not.

Fake.//ExpectedToken: Not a secret the fake holds — the token it expects callers to present. Short and plainly fake on purpose: a long random-looking value trips the pre-commit credential guard, and rightly so.
Fake.//MaxParallel: Scaleway allows 10 parallel job runs on an account with only a payment method, 50 once identity is verified. Reproduced so a backlog meets the same refusal here that it will meet there.
Fake.//Definitions: What Scaleway calls a job definition: a named template holding the image and the platform's own settings. Created once, never per run. Overridden from compose, which knows the image tag and the network name.
